tasks.title: Expose the report action through the adapter and the plan-json command
tasks.objective: Make `bitacora.py plan-json report REQ-NNN` run the module's report action via bt_plan_adapter
tasks.estimate_rationale: The module already implements report; the adapter and argument parser each need one line and a test

complexity.justification: Plumbing of an existing module action through two small files

scope.justification: Two files with one argument choice and one pass-through

duration.justification: Same shape as the earlier compat action wiring in the same files

risk.justification: Read-only report; a mistake changes output text only

coupling.justification: The web page task uses the same adapter surface

confidence.justification: Both files are under 60 lines and were read

acceptance_criteria: The report for a plan with PLAN.json prints JSON with critical_path and distribution

tasks.title: Render the summary block on the plan review page
tasks.objective: Show critical path minutes, widest level and low-confidence tasks on the web plan review page
tasks.estimate_rationale: A new block in a page renderer with HTML escaping and a legacy fallback, plus tests

complexity.justification: Rendering in an existing page with escaping and a fallback path; page layout is not fully known

scope.justification: One renderer function plus tests: a self-contained user-visible feature

duration.justification: Comparable to adding a block to this page; needs a fixture plan and byte comparison for legacy

risk.justification: Web UI for the owner; wrong output misleads review but nothing executes from it

coupling.justification: Shares the adapter surface with T1 and no other pending task edits the page

evidence: assumption:plan_panel() is the only place the plan tab is rendered (read its signature, not its body)
confidence.justification: The page was read only partly; the exact insertion point is not fixed

acceptance_criteria: The plan review page includes the summary when PLAN.json is valid
A plan without PLAN.json renders the same bytes as before

verification.purpose: integration tests including the new page cases
